alavani_thesis.label: Alavani et al. thesis reconstruction (fifteen PTX features; XGBoost and CatBoost), refit on the H100 calibration windows

planned_fit_windows.rule: the admitted windows of role fit of the same calibration document as our energy fit, same count; held-out windows excluded

alavani_thesis.reason: The thesis reconstruction cannot be set up faithfully for the H100 from what the repository holds: it needs PTX and ptxas resource records compiled for sm_90 with the CUDA 12.1 toolchain of the H100 binaries, for every evaluation kernel and for the calibrator's energy fixtures, and none exists (only cubins, SASS and cuobjdump resource lines). The Blackwell PTX is sm_120, CUDA 13.2 and its loop rules are fixed to that PTX's label numbering. Using the Blackwell-trained models, the Blackwell features or a CUDA 13.0 compile of different code than the executed binaries would not be this method on this board. Not added later (decision of 3 October 2026); the compile-only step on the login node is a decision for the user.

also_needed: PTX of every evaluation kernel compiled for sm_90 with CUDA 12.1 (nvcc -ptx and -cubin -Xptxas -v, compile only, on the Cluster login node; none exists yet: the Blackwell PTX in measured/kernel_sets/compiled/ is sm_120 and covers six kernel groups, not the reduction, transpose and copy kernels)

Departure_del_coal_s.packaged_calibration: stream bandwidth is measured, the per-request departure delay is not

Mem_LD_coal_ns.flipflop_constant: effective cost of a coalesced global load, from its load microbenchmark
Mem_LD_coal_ns.packaged_calibration: constants.chase_latency_ns (pointer-chase latency per tier, a dependent-load latency, not FlipFlop's per-load effective cost)

Mem_LD_shared_ns.packaged_calibration: constants.smem floor and slope (issue cost per request versus bank-conflict degree)

Mem_LD_uncoal_ns.packaged_calibration: no uncoalesced-load microbenchmark in the packaged calibrator

baseline_kernel_overhead_ns.flipflop_constant: fixed kernel overhead of its timing harness

idle_power.packaged_calibration: the packaged calibrator takes no idle-power window (its base power is a fitted intercept, not an idle measurement)

issue_cycles.packaged_calibration: constants.pipes (per-pipe issue cost); FlipFlop's single scalar is a different aggregate

max_power_fp.packaged_calibration: energy windows are mixed designs; no isolated maximum-activity run per component

max_power_mem.packaged_calibration: rd_dram / wr_dram windows are mixed with instruction issue

max_power_shm.packaged_calibration: shared16/shared64 windows are mixed with global loads

max_power_total.flipflop_constant: board power ceiling used as a clamp

power_alpha.packaged_calibration: needs a power sweep over active SM counts; none in the packaged calibrator

flipflop.label: FlipFlop (Rajput et al., ICSE 2026)
flipflop.reason: FlipFlop's time and power models read 22 calibration constants that come from its own calibration program. The packaged H100 calibration measures 1 of them under the same definition, has only a differently defined counterpart for 9, and has none for 12 (including idle power and the power-versus-active-SM-count law). Filling them from another board, from defaults or by a new fit would be a different method; running FlipFlop's own calibration on the H100 would give it more calibration data than our model. So the row is not run on the H100 (decision of 3 October 2026: the row is not added after the freeze).

removed_rows.accelwattch_style: AccelWattch is excluded from the executable comparison (BASELINE_CONTRACT.md, 3 October 2026); the earlier four-coefficient proxy is a reduced component model and is not a published baseline
removed_rows.alavani_refit: the ten-feature ridge adaptation is a historical adaptation, replaced by the thesis reconstruction (not run on the H100, see methods.alavani_thesis)

rules: same calibration windows as our model; nothing fitted or tuned on the evaluation cells; windows not admitted are excluded for every method alike
